entries.text: This release of DuckDB is named "Cyanoptera" after Spatula Cyanoptera, a species of duck found in western North and South America. Please also refer to the announcement blog post: https://duckdb.org/2026/10/21/announcing-duckdb-200.html What's Changed Make Identifier a class instead of using string everywhere by @Mytherin in #23161 Move to tidy-check diff again by @Mytherin in #23196 Step 3: Make duplicate eliminator optimizer logic work for CTE rewrite by @kryonix in #23187 Allow MERGE INTO in triggers by @Dtenwolde in #23179 RETURNING support for tables with triggers by @krleonid in #23153 Remove special formatting code for main CMakeLists.txt by @Mytherin in #23211 Expand aggregate state export to work with lists (StateListType) and sort keys (StateSortKey), and add aggregate state export to list, any_value/first/last, arg_min/arg_max by @Mytherin in #23199 Initial implementation of variant_array_length processing function by @sebastiaan-dev in #23167 Add row group count to parquet RETURN_STATS by @pdet in #23218 Unify ProfilerPrintFormat and ExplainFormat , remove special casing and move towards pluggable tree renderers by @Mytherin in #23222 Rework quantile to use list infrastructure by @Mytherin in #23228 Add decimal_average aggregate function by @Dtenwolde in #23097 Step 4: Make unnest rewriter recognize CTE-based plans by @kryonix in #23240 Rework ordered aggregates to use the list infrastructure by @Mytherin in #23231 Pluggable combine types rules by @yan-alex in #23
